original_text: 购买铅笔和橡皮:铅笔的数量 p 与橡皮的数量 e 都必须是整数,两者都至少为 1,都不超过 12。每支铅笔 3 元,每块橡皮 2 元,总价要恰好等于 17 元;并且要求橡皮的数量比铅笔的数量至少多 2,即 e 减去 p 的差大于或等于 2。请问:存在满足上述全部条件的整数组合 (p, e) 吗?

model.question: sat
assumptions: p and e are bounded to [1,12] as stated in the text
The price constraint 3p+2e=17 is encoded exactly
The condition e-p>=2 is encoded as a linear constraint

rendering.text:
(set-logic QF_LIA)
(declare-fun p () Int)
(declare-fun e () Int)
(assert (>= p 1))
(assert (<= p 12))
(assert (>= e 1))
(assert (<= e 12))
(assert (= (+ (* 2 e) (* 3 p)) 17))
(assert (>= (+ e (- p)) 2))
(check-sat)
(exit)
